find: if (circleVsAABB({ x, y }, radius, b).hit) legal[k] = 0;
replace: if (circleVsAABB({ x, y }, radius, b)) legal[k] = 0;
why: Drops `.hit`, restoring the exact defect this module shipped with for one commit. `circleVsAABB` returns a `Hit` OBJECT, so the condition is true whether or not the circle touched the box, and every point in each wall's rasterised neighbourhood -- the box grown by `radius` plus a step, square corners and all -- is marked illegal instead of the rounded footprint a tank really has. The mutation is subtle on purpose: the lattice still looks broadly right, because that neighbourhood mostly IS the blocked region, and a first calibration run over all 8 shipped boards at 3 player counts produced plausible numbers under it. What it actually costs is the rounded corners and one step of margin everywhere, which shows up as a 3-cell doorway reading impassable to anything wider than a 2-cell one. Pinned on the doorway control rather than on a shipped board for that reason.
killedBy: mapgen quality measures: each measure moves when its cause is introduced bottleneckWidth reads the doorway it was given, in cells
